purpose: Experiments A, B, C (descriptive).  A: how far the antecedents of prop:kernel_maintenance (e_s in E_req(x_s), u_s in U^Viab(x_s)) hold on realised trajectories of the TIPA mechanism.  B1: finite-time selection tendency of kernel-maintaining responses.  B2: acquisition in the sense of def:kernel_response_acquisition, decided exactly on periodic backgrounds by recurrence of the joint state (x, o, M, phase); 'undetermined' otherwise.  C: which antecedent is false at each step (C0 not in Viab, C1 environment only, C2 selection only, C3 both, OK none), recorded beside the realised outcome (stay in / leave the kernel) and the events (blockage, leaving K, collapse), each attributed to the class of the last step spent in the kernel.  The attribution is logical (which antecedent of the proposition failed), not causal; 'estimate error present' is recorded as co-occurrence only.
hypotheses_note: No comparative hypothesis is tested.  The only registered check is the regression H1: a step classed OK (both antecedents true, x in the kernel) never leaves the kernel (one-step form of prop:kernel_maintenance); it can fail only through an implementation error.
certificate_note: Viab_f(K) is decided by certificates ('in' / 'not_in' / 'undetermined').  U^Viab_cert is a subset of U^Viab, so u in U^Viab_cert is a lower bound and C2, C3 are upper bounds.  B2 is not run on v2 (backgrounds are not periodic).
tuning_history: Nothing tuned (v2 mechanism tuned earlier on seed 1).  Smoke test on tuning seed 1 at one point.  Before r3: tuning seeds 1-3 (default world) rerun to check memory and order independence.

hypotheses.statement: （回帰検査）両前件が成り立つ時刻（OK）に核から出る例はない（prop:kernel_maintenance の一段の形）。
hypotheses.how_it_could_fail: 判定層または記録の実装に誤りがあれば、OK の時刻に核から出る例が生じる。命題に反するので、起こるとすれば実装の誤りに限られる。回帰検査として登録する。

deviation_from_r1_r2:
r1 and r2 were registered and started; in both, a worker process was killed by the memory limit (out of memory)
and the run hung before any result was written (no evaluation output was seen).
Changes for r3: (1) the successor-table cache of the kernel oracle is cleared above 2,000 tables (the tables are
pure functions of x and are recomputed on demand; results unchanged); (2) the certificate memo is local to each
unit (in r2 it was shared across units, which would have made a unit's U^Viab_cert depend on the order in which
units are run).  Within a unit, U^Viab_cert(x) is taken with respect to the first certificate that covered x, a
valid lower bound of U^Viab(x); the counts of u in U^Viab_cert (and so C2 / C3) depend on which certificate is used.
Order independence was checked before registration on tuning seeds 1-3 (default world): identical results in both
orders.
